verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
ZUUKUKA ggwe-omwoyo gwange,
Busaasaanye-
-Era bukeeredde ddala;
Zuukuka ove mu tulo,
Waayo gy'ali
By'osobolera ddala.

verse.name: v2
v3
verse.lines:
N'obulamu bwo enkeera,
Busanye.
-Okuyita mu kabi ako,
-Olw'olubeerwa-okuva gy'ali,
N'ojja-eri ye;
-Okusinza n'amaanyi go.
